title: Computer says ‘no’: Exploring systemic bias in ChatGPT using an audit approach

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating a CV screening task using a correspondence audit approach by altering applicant names on fictitious CVs to signal different ethnic identities (e.g., Arab, Asian, Dutch, Hispanic) and comparing the quantitative interview invitation scores assigned by the model.

Substituting applicant names on simulated CVs to explicitly signal male or female gender and evaluating disparities in the model's interview invitation scores, including an analysis of intersectional effects with ethnicity and contextual bias in gender-atypical job roles.
